verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the Gusto product itself. The official MCP server and the CLI's bundled skills (e.g. cash-forecasting) let your own external AI tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, query Gusto data. That is AI working on Gusto data from outside the product, not in-product insight, so it counts only as adjacent support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
